Operation_Name_English: Replacing the old furnace and slepe with new ones, installing the sleeve in the existing chimney Tamme pst 76, in the city of Tartu

Operation_Summary_English: The project is needed in order for residents to survive this experience due to carbon monoxide and flue gases and to have a liveable temperature. As a result of the project, the ambient air in the area will become cleaner. The aim of the project is for the stove to provide warmth to the room as long as possible and for the stove, slepe and sleeve to last for at least 100 years. When carrying out the project, it is necessary to break out the old oven and slepe, build new ones instead, install a sleeve.

Projekti elluviimisel on vaja välja lõhkuda vana ahi ja slepe, selle asemele ehitada uued, paigaldada hülss.

Operation_Name_English: PÖFF Creative Gate Programme in Ida-Viru County

Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at diversifying the business sector and employment in Ida-Viru County, in order to train people to work as different technical and middle-level specialists in the production groups of audiovisual projects (movies, series, advertisements) filmed in Ida-Viru County. The audiovisual industry, together with other branches of the creative industry and service sector, is a new opportunity to find oneself, improve employment in the labour market, bring Ida-Viru County to the fore and make it visible from a completely new angle in Estonia and in the world.

Audiovisuaaltööstus koos loomemajanduse ja teenussektori teiste harudega on uus võimalus leida iseennast, parandada tööturu hõivet, tuua Ida-Virumaa esile ja teha ta nähtavaks nii Eestis kui ka maailmas täiesti uue nurga alt.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the public water supply and sewerage system of the Raasiku waste water collection area

Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to reconstruct and expand the public water supply and sewerage system in the small town of Raasiku. 6.7 km of water and 9.3 km of sewerage pipelines and 5 wastewater pumping stations will be built. 189 water and 224 sewerage connection points will be built on the registered immovables of the Raasiku waste water collection area in order to connect residents to the public water supply and sewerage system. 3.2 km of water pipelines and 0.7 km of self-flowing sewerage pipelines will be reconstructed. 30 fire hydrants are installed to ensure the supply of fire water.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks on Raasiku aleviku ühisveevärgi- ja kanalisatsiooni rekonstrueerimine ja laiendamine. Rajatakse 6,7 km vee- ja 9,3 km kanalisatsioonitorustikke ning 5 reoveepumplat. Elanike liitmiseks ühisveevärgi ja -kanalisatsiooniga rajatakse Raasiku reoveekogumisala kinnistutele 189 vee ja 224 kanalisatsiooni liitumispunkti. Rekonstrueeritakse 3,2 km veetorustikke ning 0,7 km isevoolseid kanalisatsioonitorustikke. Tuletõrjeveevarustuse tagamiseks paigaldatakse 30 tuletõrjehüdranti.

The methodology and practices based on the model are piloted over two academic years, providing the school with training, continuous training, consultation and the necessary application materials. Value propositions for attractive living and working places will also be developed in order to increase immigration and to strengthen people's sense of place and preference as a place to live. A ready-made place marketing strategy and action plan lays the foundation and ensures sustainability in the development and management of a comprehensive destination.

Operation_Summary_English: Infertility is a global problem, one of the main reasons for which is the lack of regular ovulation. Measurement of female hormones, for which there is currently no real-time measurement, contributes to the determination of ovulation. Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Viljatus on ülemaailmne probleem, mille üheks peamiseks põhjuseks on regulaarse ovulatsiooni puudumine. The LEED certificate makes real estate more attractive to both (foreign) tenants and international investors. Start-up grant helps Certify OÜ to start its activities and achieve its goals.

LEED sertifikaat muudab kinnisvara atraktiivsemaks nii (välis)rentnikele kui ka rahvusvahelistele investoritele. Starditoetus aitab Certify OÜ-l tegevusega alustada ja eesmärke täita.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of Tina, Vase and Raua district heat pipelines in Tallinn city centre

Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: Reconstruction of Tallinn Kesklinna heat pipelines is necessary in order to reduce heat losses and leakages in the district heating system. The new pipeline will increase the security of supply of the system, reduce emissions and allow to lower the temperatures of the heat network in the future. The Netherlands’ temperatures will further reduce heat losses and, in addition, enable the deployment of low-temperature heat sources such as waste heat and wastewater and seawater heat pumps. As a result, district heating customers have a carbon-neutral heat source .
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tallinn Kesklinna soojustorustike rekonstrueerimine on vajalik, et vähendada soojuskadusid ning lekked kaugküttesüsteemis. Uus torustik tõstab süsteemi varustuskindlust, vähendab heitmeid ja võimaldab tulevikus soojusvõrgu temperatuure madalmaks viia. Madalmad temperatuurid vähendavad soojuskadusid veelgi ning lisaks võimaldavad kasutusele võtta madalatemperatuurseid soojusallikaid nagu heitsoojus ning reo- ja merevee soojuspumbad. Seeläbi on kaugkütteklientidel süsinikuneutraalne soojusallikas .

Operation_Name_English: Youth-supported socialisation in Ida-Viru County
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is to support the socialisation of young people in Ida-Viru County in order to practice preparation for coping in society through learning and young people's own initiative. The programme involves 662 young people from Ida-Viru County to participate in activities with non-formal learning content to communicate in the camp method, acquire general competences and knowledge together with support youth (15 persons) from Ida-Viru County and integrate with other young people from different regions of Estonia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti üldeesmärk on Ida- Virumaa noorte sotsialiseerimise toetav kontekst, et erinevate rollida õppimise ja noore omaalgatuse kaudu harjutada ettevalmistust ühiskonnas hakkamasaamiseks. Programmiga kaasatakse 662 noort Ida- Virumaalt osalemiseks mitteformaalse õppesisuga tegevustesse laagrimeetodil suhtlemiseks, üldpädevuste ja teadmiste omandamiseks koos tuginoortega (15 in) Ida- Virumaalt ning lõimuvalt teiste noortega koos Eesti erinevatest piirkondadest.

Operation_Summary_English: CrystalSpace is conducting an applied research aimed at analyzing the state-of-the-art high-tech components available on the market to create an innovative new generation space camera system based on them. The new generation is characterized by a high video-making capability of more than 60 frames per second in HD quality and the ability to implement machine learning algorithms inside the camera. This is necessary to reduce the amount of data exchanged between the camera and the central computing system of the vehicle, such as the lunar rotor.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: CrystalSpace viib läbi rakendusuuringu, mille eesmärk on analüüsida turul saadaolevaid tipptasemel kõrgtehnoloogilisi komponente et luua nendele baseeruv innovaatiline uue generatsiooni kosmose kaamerasüsteem. Uut generatsiooni iseloomustab kõrge, enam kui 60 kaadrit sekundis video tegemise võimekus HD-kvaliteedil ning kaamera siseselt masinõppe algoritmide rakendamise võimalus. Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Eesmärk on luua terviklik strateegia linna kestliku arengu suunamiseks. Projekti käigus analüüsitakse linna praegust energiakasutust ja keskkonnamõjusid, kaardistatakse kliimariskid ning töötatakse välja konkreetsed meetmed ja tegevuskava. Samuti kaasatakse elanikke ja kohalikke ettevõtteid, et üheskoos kujundada säästlikum ja vastupidavam elukeskkond. Kliima- ja energiakava loob aluse tulevastele investeeringutele ning aitab liikuda keskkonnasõbralikuma tuleviku poole.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of Mustvee boiler house to increase energy efficiency
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to reconstruct Mustvee boiler house in order to increase energy efficiency, in the course of which a fully automatic biofuel boiler house will be built in Mustvee and the boiler system of the existing Mustvee boiler house will be reconstructed. Partially existing building volumes have been demolished from the built-up area, where a complex connected with buildings and structures has been built in the form of a fuel (chipped wood) shelter, a fuel storage facility and a channel for the reception unit. The fuel storage facility has been connected to the existing boiler plant.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks on Mustvee katlamaja rekonstrueerimine energiatõhususe suurendamiseks, mille käigus käigus ehitatakse Mustveesse biokütusel töötav täisautomaatne katlamaja ja rekonstrueeritakse Mustvee olemasoleva katlamaja kateldesüsteem. Hoonestusalalt on lammutatud osaliselt olemasolevad hoonemahud, kuhu on ehitatud hoonetest- rajatistest seotud kompleks kütuse (hakkepuidu) varjualuse, kütusehoidla ja vastuvõtusõlme kanali näol. Kütusehoidla on kokku viidud olemasoleva katlamajaga.

Operation_Name_English: Application of case management cooperation model in Rescue Board
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the availability of measures at local level to prevent aggravation of the need for assistance or support. As a result of the project, 400 people with need for assistance and support and/or their relatives have received counselling services and their coping in the home environment has improved thanks to better access to social and other support services that meet their needs. A cooperation model has been developed with local governments and other necessary parties to support those in need, which is expanding across Estonia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on parandada abi- või toetusvajaduse süvenemist ennetavate meetmete kättesaadavust kohalikul tasandil. Projekti tulemusena on 400 abi-ja toetusvajadusega inimest ja/või nende lähedast saanud nõustamisteenust ja nende toimetulek kodukeskkonnas on paranenud tänu vajadustele vastavate sotsiaal- jm abiteenuste parema kättesaadavuse. Välja on arendatud koostöömudel kohalike omavalitsuste ja teiste vajalike osapooltega abivajajate toetamiseks, mis laieneb üle Eesti.

Operation_Name_English: Acquisition of training and safety equipment for young sailors
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: MTÜ Toila Jahtklubi is applying for support from the Just Transition Fund's regional initiative support measure to ensure the sustainability of youth sailing as a recreational activity by purchasing new Aero training sailing boats and necessary training and personal protective equipment for the next age group. Better conditions bring more young people to sailing as an extremely environmentally friendly recreational activity and added value to the living environment of Ida-Viru County, which creates versatility of activity opportunities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: MTÜ Toila Jahtklubi taotleb Õiglase Ülemineku Fondi piirkondlike algatuste toetusmeetmest toetust noorte purjetamise kui huvitegevuse jätkusuutlikkuse tagamiseks, soetades järgmist vanusklassi silmas pidades uued Aero treeningpurjekad ning vajaminevat treening- ja isikukaitsevarustust. Paremad tingimused toovad purjetamise kui äärmiselt keskkonnasõbraliku huvitegevuse juurde rohkem noori ning tegevusvõimaluste mitmekülgsust loov lisaväärtust Ida- Viru maakonna elukeskkonnale.

Operation_Name_English: MB Creating a roadmap for the digitalisation of help
Category_Label: Digitising SMEs (including e-Commerce, e-Business and networked business processes, digital innovation hubs, living labs, web entrepreneurs and ICT start-ups, B2B)
Operation_Summary_English: MB Preparation of a roadmap for the digitalisation of assistance and planning of activities
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: MB Abi digitaliseerimise teekaardi koostamine ja tegevuse kavandamine

Operation_Name_English: Development of engineering solution for sewage treatment of fire extinguishing system
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop an engineering solution for the device to be developed, which means the development of documentation for the device to be developed. The design drawings and other documentation shall be made in 3D format with the possibility of re-formatting into standard drawings indicating all necessary dimensions and tolerances.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on arendatava seadme insenertehnilise lahenduse väljatöötamine, mis tähendab arendatava seadme dokumentatsiooni väljatöötamist. Projekti joonised ja muu dokumentatsioon peavad olema tehtud 3D formaadis koos võimalusega vormindada ümber tüüpjoonisteks, mis näitavad ära kõik vajalikud mõõtmed ja tolerantsid.

Operation_Name_English: EETL Development Advisor (Estonian Electronics Industry Association)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to increase the competitiveness of the members by raising their awareness, which will enable the members to increase their awareness of R&D&I and increase their respective capabilities. The long-term objective is to increase the turnover and value added of enterprises and increase their presence on international markets, in which strategic choices based on information and advice provided by the Union, effective internal and external cooperation in R&D&I and public support measures made available to enterprises and R&D institutions play a role.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Eesmärgiks on liikmete konkurentsivõime kasv läbi nende informeerituse tõstmise, mis võimaldab liikmete TAI alase teadlikkuse kasvu ja vastava võimekuse tõusu. Kaugemaks sihiks on ettevõtete käibe ja lisandväärtuse kasv ja suurem kohalolek rahvusvahelistel turgudel, milles on oma osa liidu poolt vahendatud informatsioonil ja nõustamistel põhinevatel strateegilistel valikutel, tõhusal TAI sise- ja väliskoostööl ning ettevõtetele ja TA asutustele kättesaadavaks tehtud riiklikel toetusmeetmetel.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Saaremaa Knowledge Campus concept
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The existence of regional opportunities for acquiring modern higher education and practical research and development capacities supporting the business environment are indispensable preconditions for local development and regional competitiveness in a small country. In the example of Finland ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_consortium ), a campus should also be created in Saaremaa, where different universities and institutions could settle, teach, develop research activities and collaborate in the field without major initial investments.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kaasaegse kõrghariduse omandamise regionaalsete võimaluste ja ettevõtluskeskkonda toetavate praktilise teadus-arendustegevuste võimekuste olemasolu on väikeriigi kohaliku arengu ning piirkondliku konkurentsivõime vältimatud eeltingimused. Soome näitel ( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_consortium ) peaks ka Saaremaal looma linnaku, kus erinevad ülikoolid ja institutsioonid saaksid ilma suurte alginvesteeringuteta asuda, õpetada, arendada teadustegevusi ja teha valdkondlikku kootööd.

Operation_Name_English: Boosting research and development in the wooden house sector (Estonian Woodhouse Association)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Puitmajasektori teadus- ja arendustegevuse hoogustamine (Eesti Puitmajaliit)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The ambition of the Estonian wooden house sector in the coming years is to attract 2,000 new qualified employees and double the turnover to 1 billion euros. This requires a significant increase in the contribution of companies to R&D. The main task of the development adviser of the Wooden Houses Association will be to prepare the "Strategy for boosting the development activities of the wooden house sector" together with the action plan and to be the leader of it together with enterprises and R&D institutions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Eesti puitmajasektori ambitsioon on lähiaastatel juurde tuua 2000 uut kvalifitseeritut töötajat ning kahekordistada käivet 1 miljardi euroni. See eeldab ettevõtete märgatavalt suuremat panustamist teadus- ja arendustegevustele. Puitmajaliidu arendusnõuniku peamiseks ülesandeks saab olema "Puitmajasektori arendustegevuste hoogustamise strateegia" koostamine ühes tegevusplaaniga ning selle eestvedajaks olemine koos ettevõtete ja TA asutustega.

Operation_Name_English: Copper Motors
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of Vask Motors OÜ is aimed at increasing the capacity of mobile maintenance and repair services of heavy machinery in Järva County. The goal is to acquire the necessary diagnostic equipment and tools that will help to expand the range of services offered and improve efficiency. As a result of the project, 2 jobs will be created during the project period, the customer base will be increased and the additional costs arising from rental equipment will be reduced, providing customers with a faster and higher-quality service.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Vask Motors OÜ projekt on suunatud rasketehnika mobiilse hooldus- ja remonditeenuse võimekuse suurendamisele Järvamaal. Eesmärk on soetada vajalikud diagnostikaseadmed ja tööriistad, mis aitavad laiendada pakutavate teenuste valikut ja parandada efektiivsust. Projekti tulemusena luuakse projektiperioodil 2 töökohta, suurendatakse kliendibaasi ning vähendatakse rendiseadmetest tulenevaid lisakulusid, pakkudes klientidele kiiremat ja kvaliteetsemat teenust.

Operation_Name_English: Iron Stone - Acquisition of equipment necessary for the production of earthstone tiles
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Raudkivi - maakiviplaatide tootmiseks vajalike seadmete soetamine
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Groundstone OÜ's (Raudkivi) project is aimed at increasing the production and sale of stone tiles from natural stone in Valga County. In the course of the project, the necessary production equipment and lifting equipment will be acquired, which will significantly increase the production capacity and improve the efficiency of the activities. As a result of the project, 1 job will be created and the total product of Valgamaa will be contributed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Groundstone OÜ (Raudkivi) projekt on suunatud looduslikust maakivist kiviplaatide tootmise ja müügi kasvatamiseks Valgamaal. Projekti käigus soetatakse vajalikke tootmisseadmeid ja tõstetehnika, mis kasvatavad oluliselt tootmisvõimekust ning parandavad tegevuste efektiivsust. Projekti tulemusel luuakse 1 töökoht ning panustatakse Valgamaa koguprodukti.

Operation_Name_English: Algae and box for products!
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the help of the project "Algae and shellfish for products!", a new job will be created in Hiiumaa, with the help of which solutions will be found to enhance the value of red algae and mussels grown in the sea near Hiiumaa. In addition, management of various environmental projects in the field of aquaculture.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti "Vetikas ja karbid toodeteks!" abil luuakse Hiiumaale uus töökoht, mille abil hakatakse leidma lahendusi väärindamaks Hiiumaa lähistel meres kasvatatavale punavetikale ja rannakarbile. Lisaks erinevate keskkonnaprojektide juhtimine vesiviljelusvaldkonnas.

Operation_Name_English: Green deed in Rabatalus
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Green Deed in Rabatalus" is to promote environmental awareness, develop practical knowledge of nature and strengthen local identity. For this purpose, an event called "Smart Free Community Day" will be organised, a calendar will be published and a travelling exhibition will be prepared. As a result of the project, people acquire an environment- and community-centred way of thinking and thereby are able to create a good living environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Mittetulundusühing Rabatalu Loodushariduskeskus projekti "Rohetegu Rabatalus" eesmärgiks on keskkonnateadlikkuse edendamine, praktilise loodusetundmise arendamine ning kohaliku identiteedi tugevdamine . Selleks korraldatakse üritus "Nutivaba kogukonnapäev", antakse välja kalender ja koostatakse rändnäitus. Projekti tulemusel omandavad inimesed keskkonna- ja kogukonnakeskse mõtteviisi ning seeläbi oskavad luua head elukeskkonda.

Operation_Name_English: Renovation of the oven Jannsen 19 private house
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve air quality in a densely populated area by replacing the existing solid fuel heater with a modern and more environmentally friendly solution. As part of the project, the old heater will be dismantled and a new, energy-efficient system will be installed, which will significantly reduce pollutant emissions and improve the living environment of the residents.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on parandada tiheasustuspiirkonna õhukvaliteeti, asendades olemasoleva tahkel kütusel põhineva kütteseadme kaasaegse ja keskkonnasõbralikuma lahendusega. Projekti raames demonteeritakse vana kütteseade ning paigaldatakse uus, energiatõhus süsteem, mis vähendab oluliselt saasteainete emissiooni ja parandab elanike elukeskkonda.

Operation_Name_English: OSHINO Electronics Estonia Investments in Resource Efficiency
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OSHINO Electronics Estonia Osaühing ressursitõhususe investeeringud
Category_Label: Support to environmentally-friendly production processes and resource efficiency in large enterprises
Operation_Summary_English: The main field of activity of OSHINO Electronics Estonia OÜ is the production and marketing of electronic products for the automotive industry and other industrial sectors. The project aims to contribute to environmental objectives, reduce greenhouse gas emissions per unit of production, improve resource use and resource productivity, and save raw materials and energy. To do this, an SMT-line assembly robot and soldering paste control device will be purchased.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: OSHINO Electronics Estonia OÜ põhitegevusala on elektroonikatoodete tootmine ja turustamine autotööstusele ning muudele tööstusvaldkondadele. Projekti eesmärk on panustada keskkonnaeesmärkide saavutamisse, vähendada kasvuhoonegaaside heidet toodanguühiku kohta, parandada ressursikasutust ja ressursitootlikkust ning säästa toormaterjale ja energiat. Selleks soetatakse SMT-liini montaažirobot ja jootepasta kontrollseade.

Operation_Name_English: Energy efficiency of Kuressaare Centre for the Development and Provision of Integrated Welfare Services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kuressaare integreeritud heaoluteenuste arendamise ja osutamise keskuse energiatõhusus
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the energy efficiency of the 1st and 2nd floors of the A-housing, the B-housing and the 1st and 2nd floors of the C-housing, by reconstructing the technical systems of these housings and the spatial solutions concerning them. Reconstruction works are planned in relation to energy efficiency improvements (including the installation of solar panels), the construction of heat recovery ventilation systems, the replacement of opening fillings and the refurbishment of premises due to service needs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti sisuks on suurendada A-korpuse 1. ja 2. korruse, B-korpuse ja C-korpuse 1. ja 2. korruse energiatõhusust, rekonstrueerides nimetatud korpuste tehnosüsteemid ja neid puudutavad ruumilahendused. Kavandatud on rekonstrueerimistööd seoses energiatõhususe parandamisega (sh päikesepaneelide paigaldamine), soojustagastusega ventilatsioonisüsteemide rajamisega, avatäidete vahetusega ja ruumide teenusevajadusest tingitud ümberehitusega.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of apartment building Trummi 21b, Tallinn
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the full-scale renovation of the apartment building is to reduce the weighted energy consumption by 213 kWh/m2*a, i.e. to achieve energy class C. As a result of the renovation, the energy consumption of the building will decrease, the indoor climate will improve, safety and the attractiveness of the residential building and the area will increase. In addition, emissions from climate change into the environment will be reduced and community communication and security will be improved.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Korterelamu täiemahulise rekonstrueerimise eesmärgiks on kaalutud energiatarbe 213 kWh/m2*a. vähendamine 149 kWh/m2*a, ehk energiaklassi C saavutamine. Rekonstrueerimise tulemusel väheneb hoone energiatarve, paraneb sisekliima, suurenevad ohutus ja elamu ning piirkonna atraktiivsus. Lisaks vähenevad keskkonda suunatavad kliimamuutuseid põhjustavad heitkogused ning paraneb kogukondlik suhtlus ja turvalisus.

Operation_Name_English: EA-BESS
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: ElectroAir BESS (Battery Energy Storage Solution) is an innovative system that enables the efficient accumulation, storage and use of electricity. The system helps to optimise energy use, reduce dependence on the electricity grid and ensure energy security also in crisis situations. It is able to collect energy from renewable sources such as solar and wind energy and, if necessary, return excess energy to the grid. ElectroAir BESS is an important step towards a cleaner and more stable energy future!
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: ElectroAir BESS (Battery Energy Storage Solution) on innovatiivne süsteem, mis võimaldab elektrienergia tõhusat akkumuleerimist, salvestamist ja kasutamist. Süsteem aitab optimeerida energiakasutust, vähendada sõltuvust elektrivõrgust ning tagada energiajulgeoleku ka kriisiolukordades. See suudab koguda energiat taastuvatest allikatest, nagu päikese- ja tuuleenergia, ning vajadusel tagastada liigse energia võrku. ElectroAir BESS on oluline samm puhtama ja stabiilsema energia tuleviku suunas!

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of apartment building Metsa 2, Kuremaa, Jõgevamaa
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: With the use of this design construction contract, the building's exterior walls will be insulated along with the renewal of the exterior finishing and technical systems will be reconstructed. The solutions proposed are based on the rational use of economic resources. The New European Bauhaus will be followed to ensure that spatial solutions are beautiful, inclusive and sustainable at the same time. At the same time, these principles align with the ‘Estonia 2035’ strategy and the basic principles of quality space.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Käesoleva projekteerimise ehituse töövõtu kasutamisega soojustatakse hoone välipiirded koos välisviimistluse uuendamisega ja rekonstrueeritakse tehnosüsteemid. Projekteeritavad lahendused lähtuvad majanduslikke ressursside otstarbekast kasutamisest. Järgitakse Euroopa uut Bauhaus -i, et ruumilahendused oleksid ühtaegu kaunid, kaasavad ja kestlikud. Ühtlasi joonduvad need põhimõtted „Eesti 2035“ strateegia ja kvaliteetse ruumi aluspõhimõtetega.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the services of Märjamaa Music and Art School
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Märjamaa Muusika- ja Kunstikooli teenuste parendamine
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Within the framework of the project, the availability and quality of the services of Märjamaa Music and Art School will be improved and expanded, a modern, energy-efficient centre will be created, which will provide a hobby education and recreational activity service corresponding to the needs of the community, the capacity to provide services will be increased, and the building part of Märjamaa Gymnasium will be reconstructed to be suitable for Märjamaa Music and Art School.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti raames parendatakse ja laiendatakse Märjamaa Muusika- ja Kunstikooli teenuste kättesaadavust ja kvaliteeti, luuakse kaasaegne, energiasäästlik keskus, mis pakub kogukonna vajadusetele vastavat huvihariduse ja huvitegevuse teenust, suurendatakse teenuste osutamise võimekust ning rekonstrueeritakse Märjamaa Gümnaasiumi hooneosa Märjamaa Muusika- ja Kunstikoolile sobivaks.

Operation_Name_English: Water management project for Rõuge and Varstu wastewater collection areas
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Within the framework of the project, public water supply and sewerage facilities will be built in the small town of Rõuge to the following extent: 1. Total public water supply pipelines 3602, etc.; 2. The total number of public sewerage pipelines is 3248, etc.; 3. 275, etc. In the framework of the project, public water supply and sewerage facilities will be built in the small town of Varstu to the following extent: 1. Total public water supply pipelines 978, etc.; 2. Total public sewerage pipelines 1940, etc.; 3. Pressure sewerage pipeline 320 etc.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti raames rajatakse Rõuge alevikus ühisveevärgi ja -kanalisatsiooni rajatisi järgmises mahus: 1. Ühisveevarustuse torustikke kokku 3602 jm; 2. Ühiskanalisatsiooni torustikke kokku 3248 jm; 3. Survekanalisatsiooni torustikku 275 jm. Projekti raames rajatakse Varstu alevikus ühisveevärgi ja -kanalisatsiooni rajatisi järgmises mahus: 1. Ühisveevarustuse torustikke kokku 978 jm; 2. Ühiskanalisatsiooni torustikke kokku 1940 jm; 3. Survekanalisatsiooni torustikku 320 jm.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of inclusive education in Haapsalu city
Category_Label: Infrastructure for primary and secondary education
Operation_Summary_English: In order to better implement inclusive education in schools in the city of Haapsalu, general education schools and an art school and a hobby centre will be supported to support the coherence of formal and non-formal learning of pupils with the design of spaces and the acquisition of technical equipment . Low adventure trails will be established for Ridala Basic School and Uuemõisa School. All schools will be provided with technical equipment to help illustrate what they are learning. To create the necessary space to support concentration for HEV students, we acquire screens and ergonomic seats.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Haapsalu linna koolides kaasava hariduse paremaks rakendamiseks toetatakse üldhariduskoole ning kunstikooli ja huvikeskust, et toetada õpilaste formaal- ja mitteformaalõppe sidusust ruumide kujundamisega ning tehniliste vahendite soetamisega . Ridala Põhikoolile ja Uuemõisa kooli rajatakse madalseiklusrajad. Kõikidele koolidele soetatakse tehnilisi vahendeid, mis aitavad õpitavat näitlikustada. HEV õpilastele vajaliku keskendumist toetava ruumi loomiseks soetame sirmid ja ergonoomilisi istmeid.

Operation_Name_English: Kose Rural Municipality Tourism Development Plan 2035
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: To create a comprehensive tourism development plan for Kose rural municipality for 2025-2035, which supports the development of tourism, culture, environment and economic life in the region.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Luua terviklik Kose valla turismi arengukava aastateks 2025-2035, mis toetab piirkonna turismi, kultuuri, keskkonna ja majanduselu arengut.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading the heating system
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: Upgrading and modernising the heating system in a densely populated area.

Operation_Name_English: Replacement of the heating unit with a more energy efficient one
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Asendada olemasolev tahkeküttekatel kliimaneutraalsema õhk-vesi soojuspumbaga.

Operation_Name_English: Start of production of recreational craft made of HDPE material in Saaremaa
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: HDPE materjalist väikelaevade tootmise alustamine Saaremaal
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide start-up capital for a new company engaged in the construction of recreational craft. According to the business plan, new HDPE plastic recreational craft will be manufactured, which will have long-lasting and favourable characteristics, lower maintenance costs and a lower carbon footprint for the environment. HDPE material is an unjustifiably undervalued shipbuilding material in the world. In recent years, due to its strong technical and economic advantages, it is gaining popularity and is being used in particularly demanding conditions.

Operation_Summary_English: The area of activity of Virumaa Kootöökogu MTÜ (VIKO) is characterised by a high proportion of elderly and disabled people, sparse population, multilingualism, low number of service providers and weak cohesion of communities. In the new LEADER period, one of our strands of action will be to engage, support and create action opportunities for target groups with the support of an ESF+ action. Operation_Summary_English: The house was built in the 1960s and 1980s. The energy label of the apartment building is poor. There is no insulation on all the borders of the house. The apartments at the end of the house are cold. As heat is consumed according to the needs of colder apartments, excess energy is spent on average. The joints of old radiators tend to leak. Kuna soojust tarbitakse külmemate korterite vajadustest lähtuvalt, kulutatuakse keskmistele üleliigset energiat. Vanade radiaatorite liitekohad kipuvad lekkima. Korterelamu rekonstrueerimine parema energiatõhususe ja sisekliima parandamine ning hoone eluea pikendamine ja väärtuse tõstmine.

Prototüüp keskendub autonoomsele ja energiatõhusale tehnoloogiale, mis suudab tegutseda erinevates veekogudes, pakkudes täpseid ja reaalajas andmeid. Regalecus OÜ missiooniks on arendada soodne kuid mitmekülgne meredroon, mis vastab nii teadlaste, ettevõtjate kui ka keskkonnahoiu spetsialistide vajadustele.

The restaurant offers high-quality catering services with beautiful views of Ontika's cliff coast and Oru Park. The project will create jobs and support the regional economy, making Toila a more attractive destination for both locals and tourists. The project strengthens Karand OÜ's market position and contributes to the development of Ida-Viru County. The opening of the restaurant is planned for 2026.

Restoran pakub kõrgekvaliteedilist toitlustusteenust kaunite vaadetega Ontika pankrannikule ja Oru parki. Projekt loob töökohti ja toetab piirkonna majandust, muutes Toila atraktiivsemaks sihtkohaks nii kohalikele kui ka turistidele. Projekt tugevdab Karand OÜ turupositsiooni ja panustab Ida-Virumaa arengusse. Restorani avamine on kavandatud 2026. aastal.

Operation_Name_English: Doctoral studies in knowledge transfer to study Arvo Pärt's early composing and to make the digital archive of the Arvo Pärt Centre more user-efficient by creating content maps of large audio and video files
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Teadmussiirdedoktorantuur Arvo Pärdi varase heliloomingu uurimiseks ja Arvo Pärdi Keskuse digitaalarhiivi kasutajatõhusamaks muutmiseks mahukate heli- ja videofailide sisukaartide loomisega
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: In order to develop the digital database that manages Arvo Pärt's personal archive, APK will send a researcher and archival specialist from the EAMT's doctoral studies centre. Maarja Tyler's doctoral thesis "Expression of Modernism and Avant-garde in Soviet Estonian Music on the Example of Arvo Pärt's Work" focuses on an unexplored period in Estonian music, uses unexplored materials and reveals the influence of Pärt's early work in Soviet Estonian music. As a result of research, the digital database will be supplemented with new content entries, the information will become more structured and efficient.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Arvo Pärdi isikuarhiivi haldava digiandmebaasi arendamiseks lähetab APK EMTA doktorantuuri keskuse teaduri ja arhiivispetsialisti. Maarja Tyleri doktoritöö „Modernismi ja avangardi avaldumine Nõukogude Eesti muusikas Arvo Pärdi loomingu näitel“ keskendub seni käsitlemata perioodile Eesti muusikas, kasutab uurimata materjale ja avab Pärdi varajase loomingu mõju Nõukogude Eesti muusikas. Teadustöö tulemusel täieneb digiandmebaas uute sisukirjetega, info muutub struktureeritumaks ja efektiivsemaks.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektiga rekonstrueeritakse Väimela aleviku kaugkütte katlamaja, mis hetkel kasutab 100% fossiilseid kütuseid - põlevkiviõli. Operation_Summary_English: The doctoral thesis focuses on the development of a methodology for measuring the flow of rivers using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). As a result, the Environmental Agency will receive an effective tool that helps to estimate the flow of Estonian rivers with sufficient accuracy.

Draft-Line uses state-of-the-art sensor systems and data analytics to provide real-time accurate insight into changes in the draught of a ship, providing visual insight into the ship's crew, harbor and cargo owners.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Draft-Line on innovatiivne ja nutikas digilahendus, mis võimaldab laeva süvise täpset ja automaatset mõõtmist reaalajas, optimeerides lastimis- ja lossimisprotsesse, vähendades süvise mõõtmisvigadest tingitud kulusid ja kadusid ning suurendades meretranspordi efektiivsust. Draft-Line kasutab kaasaegseid andurisüsteeme ja andmeanalüütikat , et pakkuda reaalajas täpset ülevaadet laeva süvise muutustest, pakkudes visuaalset ülevaadet laevaperele, sadamale ja kaubaomanikele.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Ida-Viru region's waterway network and business development project is to improve the connection of the region's waterways between the North Coast and Peipus and to develop a network of entrepreneurs around them. In addition, reorganise business support services to support entrepreneurs and increase the attractiveness of the region. The connecting link of the project is the Narva-Jõesuu mule, which will be renovated, ensuring a better connection to the Narva River and creating additional opportunities for the mule to provide services.

Lisaks sellele korraldada ümber ettevõtluse tugiteenused ettevõtjate toetamiseks ja piirkonna atraktiivsuse tõstmiseks. Projekti ühendavaks lüliks on Narva-Jõesuu muul, mis renoveeritakse, tagades Narva jõele parem ühendus ning luues muulile täiendavaid võimalusi teenuste pakkumiseks.

Within the framework of the project activities, funds will be acquired to ensure temporary access for wheelchair users to the educational buildings of Kiviõli State School and Kiviõli School of Arts. Operation_Name_English: Health research - the impact of functional foods on the gut microbiome and health outcomes
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Terviseuuringud - funktsionaalsete toitude mõju soolemikrobioomile ja tervisenäitajatele
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop an analysis platform that allows to find links between eating habits, lifestyle, health problems and microbiome and to assess how it could be influenced by the consumption of different functional foods in order to reduce/prevent the occurrence of health problems and improve the general well-being of the person. It will develop a range of analytical methods that can be used to draw evidence-based conclusions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks on arendada välja analüüsiplatvorm, mis võimaldab leida seoseid toitumisharjumuste, elustiili, tervisprobleemide ja mikrobioomi vahel ning hinnata, kuidas oleks seda võimalik mõjutada erinevate funktsionaalsete toitude tarbimisega, et vähendada/ennetada terviseprobleemide esinemist ja tõsta inimese üldist heaolu. Selle raames arendatakse välja erinevaid analüüsimeetodeid, mida kasutades oleks võimalik teha tõenduspõhiseid järeldusi.

During the project there will be practical workshops where handicraft techniques and recycling of old objects will be taught. Participants will learn about the sustainable use of resources and develop their creativity. The project will increase people's awareness of ecological consumption, their craft skills will improve and a sustainable and responsible lifestyle will be strengthened in the community.

Osalejad omandavad teadmisi ressursside säästlikust kasutamisest ning arendavad oma loovust. Projekt suureneb inimeste teadlikkus ökoloogilisest tarbimisest, nende käsitööoskused paranevad ning kogukonnas tugevneb jätkusuutlik ja vastutustundlik eluviis.

The share of exports exceeds 70%, reaching more than 70 countries. The project aims to increase sales to at least EUR 1.1 million in 2024 and EUR 1.3 million by 2025, maintaining the existing export share. The project involves the protection of intellectual property, the strengthening of partnerships and other important aspects.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Asutatud 2015. aastal, Von Baer OÜ on innovaatiline ettevõte, mis disainib ja turustab ülemaailmselt kvaliteetseid nahktooteid. Ettevõtte tegevus toimub Eestis. Projekti eesmärgiks on tõsta müügikäivet 2024. aastal vähemalt 1,1 miljoni euroni ja 2025. aastaks 1,3 miljoni euroni, säilitades olemasolevat ekspordi osakaalu. Join us and be part of a positive change in our region!

Liituge meiega ja olge osa positiivsest muutusest meie piirkonnas!

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of district heating pipelines at Viru pst and Kesk tn in the city of Sillamäe - Ranna tn
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sillamäe linna Viru pst ja Kesk tn - Ranna tn kaugküttetorustike rekonstrueerimine
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: The old depreciated pipes of Sillamäe city's Kesk tn - Ranna tn and Viru boulevards are replaced by new pre-insulated pipes. As a result of the project, the heat loss on the section to be renovated will be reduced by 85,7 %. As Silpower AS partially uses fossil fuels as fuel to produce thermal energy, the renovation will reduce fuel consumption and air emissions, and improve air quality.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Sillamäe linna Kesk tn - Ranna tn ja Viru puiesteede soojustrasside vanad amortiseerunud torud asendatakse uute eelisoleeritud torudega. Projekti tulemusena väheneb soojuskadu renoveeritaval lõigul 85,7 %. Kuna soojusenergia tootmiseks kasutab Silpower AS kütuseks osaliselt fossiilsed kütused, väheneb renoveerimise tulemusena kütuse kulu ning õhuheitmed, paraneb õhu kvaliteet.

Operation_Name_English: Ida-Viru Summer School for Language Teachers
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: Within the framework of the project, a training series for language teachers from Ida-Viru County will be organised with a trip to Lake Peipus. The main topics are language teaching without a base language and online learning methodologies, raising awareness of entrepreneurship among language teachers, and experiential counselling. The teachers raise their qualifications, as a result of which they can offer high-quality modern language learning to the residents of the county at different levels of education and create a language environment that supports and motivates the learner immediately in the lessons.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti raames korraldatakse Ida-Virumaa keeleõpetajatele koolitussari väljasõiduga Peipsi järve äärde. Peamiseks teemaks on keele õpetamine baaskeeleta ning veebiõppe metoodikad, teadliku ettevõtlikkuse tõstmine keeleõpetajate hulgas ja kogemusnõustamine. Õpetajad tõstavad oma kvalifikatsiooni, mille tulemusena saavad pakkuda erinevates haridustasemetes maakonna elanikele kvaliteetset tänapäevast keeleõpet ja luua koheselt tundides õppijat toetav ja motiveeriv keelekeskkond.

Operation_Name_English: Refurbishment of the fireplace (furnace) of dune 12
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: In a house older than 50, there is a fireplace (oven) that needs to be replaced. Heating is dangerous, with a large environmental footprint. Replacing the old furnace will contribute to meeting the climate targets, as well as improving the outdoor air in the densely populated area. The modular furnace based on solid fuel meets fire safety requirements, which makes heating energy efficient. The new stove will provide the residents of the house with the opportunity to heat without any problems and will also reduce the need to use large amounts of solid fuel.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Üle 50.a vanuses majas on küttekolle (ahi), mis vajab välja vahetamist. Kütmine on ohtlik, suure keskkonna jalajäljega. Vana ahju vahetamine aitab kaasa kliimaeesmärkide täitmisele, samuti paraneb tiheasutusala välisõhk. Tahkel kütusel põhinev moodulahi vastab tuleohutusnõuetele, mis muudab kütmise energiaefektiivseks. Uus ahi tagab majas elavatele elanikele võimaluse kütta ilma probleemideta ning väheneb ka vajadus kasutada suures koguses tahket kütust.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of air-to-water heating system
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: Replacing a solid-fuelled air-fired fireplace with air-to-water heat pumps and radiators ensures an environmentally friendly and efficient heating solution that does not contaminate the environment with flue gases and soot and uses the maximum amount of self-generated electricity to produce heat and hot water. In low-density residential areas, the living environment of all residents improves and energy consumption decreases.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tahkekütusel töötava õhkküttega kamina asendamine õhk-vesi soojuspumba- ja radiaatoritega tagab keskkonnasõbraliku ja effektiivse küttelahenduse, mis ei saasta suitsugaaside ja tahmaga keskkonda ja kasutab maksimaalselt enda toodetud elektrienergiat soojuse ja sooja vee tootmiseks. Madal-tihedates elurajoonides paraneb kõikide elanike elukeskkond ja väheneb energiatarbimine.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on Pärnu linnas asuvas väikeelamus asendada tahkeküttel põhinev kütteseade taastuvenergiaallikat kasutava kütteseadmega, et parandada elamu küttesüsteemi tuleohutust ning energiaefektiivsust. Operation_Name_English: DHNB2025 Conference
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments

The annual network of researchers in digital data, methods and users of humanities and culture Digital Humanities in the Nordic and Baltic Countries is the largest in the region and provides an opportunity to bring digital culture and practice researchers to Estonia who are looking for inspiration and solutions to help make decisions in the future.

Iga-aastane humanitaaria ja kultuurivaldkonna digitaalsete andmete, meetodite ja kasutajate uurijate võrgustik Digital Humanities in the Nordic and Baltic Countries on piirkonna suurim ning annab võimaluse tuua Eestisse digitaalse kultuuri ja praktikate uurijad, kes otsivad inspiratsiooni ja lahendusi, mis aitaksid tulevikus otsuseid langetada.

Operation_Name_English: East-Viru Winter School for Language Teachers

Operation_Name_English: Study and analysis of the water quality status of Lake Türi
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Türi järve veekvaliteedi seisundi uuring ja analüüs
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: According to the Health Board, the status of Lake Türi is deteriorating, endangering the ecological balance of the lake and its use as a bathing site. The aim of the project is to conduct a complex study of Lake Türi in cooperation with a consultant and the Estonian University of Life Sciences and to prepare a summary report of the assessment of the state of Lake Türi and a package of measures for the improvement of Lake Türi. These activities provide the basis for improving the condition of the lake to ensure its ecological balance and long-term use as a safe bathing site.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Vastavalt Terviseameti andmetele on Türi järve seisund halvenemas, ohustades järve ökoloogilist tasakaalu ja kasutust supluskohana. Projekti eesmärk on viia koostöös konsultandi ja Eesti Maaülikooliga läbi Türi järve kompleksuuring ja koostada Türi järve seisundi hinnangu koondaruanne ning Türi järve parendamise meetmetepakett. Need tegevused loovad aluse järve seisundi parendamiseks, et tagada järve ökoloogiline tasakaal ning pikaajaline kasutus turvalise supluskohana.

Operation_Name_English: Mentor training for Alutaguse Folk Musicians and participation in the folklore festival EUROPEADE 2025

The final result of the training will be the performance of folk musicians at the international folklore festival "EUROPEADE 2025". We focus on people's interests and strengths, support their need to belong and create different opportunities for development (excursions, joint events). Teopesa is a discovery center where people first discover themselves, then others, and then the surrounding environment and the world at large.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Teopesa on abi- ja toetusvajadusega inimeste tegevuskeskus Raplas, mille eesmärk on kasvatada abivajavate inimeste iseseisvat toimetulekuvõimet. The results can be used in the design of prevention and intervention models, in research and teaching, and in assessing the effectiveness of existing programmes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt toetab Tartu Tervishoiu Kõrgkooli teadus- ja õppetöö arendamist vaimse tervise valdkonnas. Operation_Summary_English: The project will rebuild the street space on the Tallinn highway by dividing the street space in favour of sustainable modes of movement, and build a greener and more climate-proof urban space. The aim of the works is to improve the mobility of pedestrians and non-motorised road users, to increase the level of road safety, to find a good street space solution, to increase electrical safety and to solve the problems related to floods caused by rainwater. The project area includes a 509-metre open-air space from the Central Square to Luha Street.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project ‘Mushroom and viral diseases in rape in Estonian conditions’ is to investigate fungal and viral diseases affecting the yield and quality of rapeseed. As a homeowner, I want to reduce emissions from heating. To achieve this, I want to replace the old fireplace with a new and more efficient one.

In the course of the project, the position of a youth well-being specialist will be created in each local government and the position of a cross-municipal coordinator with 0.5 workload, whose main task is to analyse the results of the activities performed and coordinate the wider network work. The project will support at least 180 young people in a NEET situation, of whom at least 25% will continue to work.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Käesolev projekt on viie Lääne-Harju KOVi ühisprojekt: Harku vald, Keila linn, Kiili vald, Lääne-Harju vald ja Saku vald. The implementation of the project will improve the fire safety of the residential heating system, increase energy efficiency and reduce air pollution in densely populated areas. Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to prepare a roadmap for the digitalisation of Krah Pipes OÜ, which proposes digitalisation and automation solutions, assesses the cost-effectiveness and impact of digitalisation, as well as the necessary investments to achieve the goals, and creates a time and action plan for digitalisation.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of Viru pst II stage in Sillamäe
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Viru pst rekonstrueerimine II etapp Sillamäel
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The promenaded and historic urban space of Viru pst will be reconstructed, preserving the historical design principles, but renewing the elements of the street to create a modern public space where people are welcome to spend time, where walking and cycling are safe. The boulevard is divided by its nature into areas intended for movement, so-called sections of the boulevard and the squares or stopping points between them. Environmentally friendly solutions, such as green asphalt, are used to create high-quality public spaces.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rekonstrueeritakse Viru pst promenaadne ja ajalooline linnaruum, säilitades ajastutruud kujunduspõhimõtted, kuid uuendades tänava elemente, et luua tänapäevane avalik ruum, kuhu inimesed on oodatud aega veetma, kus on ohutu liigelda jalgsi ja jalgrattaga . Puiestee jaguneb oma iseloomult liikumiseks mõeldud aladeks, nö puiestee lõikudeks ja nende vahele jäävateks väljakuteks ehk peatuspunktideks. Kvaliteetsele avaliku ruumi loomisel kasutatakse keskkonnasõbralikke lahendusi, nagu roheasfalt.

Operation_Name_English: Resource efficiency investments of TOODE
Category_Label: Support to environmentally-friendly production processes and resource efficiency in large enterprises
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to save energy and increase production while at the same time making production more efficient and production of higher quality . In order to achieve the objective of the project, a new leaf processing centre will be acquired, as a result of which the use of the company's resources will improve and the company's resource productivity will increase.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on hoida kokku energiat ja suurendada tootmismahtu muutes samal ajal tootmine efektiivsemaks ning toodang kvaliteetsemaks . Projekti eesmärgi saavutamiseks soetatakse uus lehetöötluskeskus, mille kasutuselevõtmise tulemusena paraneb ettevõtte ressursikasutus ning tõuseb ettevõtte ressursitootlikkus.

Operation_Name_English: Production of nodule moulding pulp
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Nupik modelling mass is a natural handmade plastic line that offers children a safe and environmentally friendly alternative to synthetic modelling masses. The need for the project stems from the growing demand for ecological and health-friendly products that contribute to the development of children's creativity and manual skills. Activities include product development, marketing campaigns and cooperation with educational institutions. As a result of the project, awareness of the importance of natural products and sustainability of consumption will increase.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nupik voolimismass on naturaalne käsitöö plastiliin, mis pakub lastele ohutut ja keskkonnasõbralikku alternatiivi sünteetilistele voolimismassidele. Vajadus projekti järele tuleneb kasvavast nõudlusest ökoloogiliste ja tervisesõbralike toodete järele, mis aitavad kaasa laste loovuse ja käeliste oskuste arengule. Tegevused hõlmavad tootearendust, turunduskampaaniaid ning koostööd haridusasutustega. Projekti tulemusena tõuseb teadlikkus looduslike toodete olulisusest ja jätkusuutlikkust tarbimist.

Operation_Name_English: Lääne-Nigula parish, Linnamäe village, Kooli tee 7 apartment association

Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: The house was built in 60-80 years. The energy label of the apartment building is poor. There is no insulation on all the borders of the house. The apartments at the end of the house are cold. As heat is consumed according to the needs of colder apartments, excess energy is spent on average. The joints of old radiators tend to leak. Reconstruction of an apartment building to improve energy efficiency and indoor climate, and to extend the lifespan and increase the value of the building.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Maja on ehitatud 60-80 aastal. Korterelamu energiamärgis on kehv. Kõikidel maja piiretel puudub soojustus. Maja otstes olevad korterid on külmad. Kuna soojust tarbitakse külmemate korterite vajadustest lähtuvalt, kulutatakse keskmistele üleliigset energiat. Vanade radiaatorite liitekohad kipuvad lekkima. Korterelamu rekonstrueerimine parema energiatõhususe ja sisekliima parandamine ning hoone eluea pikendamine ja väärtuse tõstmine.

Operation_Summary_English: The Ants Veod project is aimed at increasing transport capacity and improving environmental sustainability. The project will acquire additional trailers to increase transport volumes by at least 20%, reduce CO2 emissions and expand the service spectrum. The goal is to offer more efficient and flexible transport solutions for both private and business customers. As a result of the project, the economic situation of the company will improve, competitiveness will increase and customer satisfaction will increase. The project is supported by EU funds.

Projekti tulemusena paraneb ettevõtte majandusseis,suureneb konkurentsivõime ning tõuseb klientide rahulolu. Projekti toetavad EL vahendid.

Operation_Name_English: Development of adult guardianship in the city of Tallinn
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Täisealiste eestkoste valdkonna arendamine Tallinna linnas
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to long-term care (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide the City of Tallinn's wards, who are in Tallinn, with social and other services tailored to their needs, which will help them cope more independently in a way that is less detrimental to their autonomy in the future. During the project, the boundaries of guardianship will be clarified and input will be provided for the development of social services. As a result of the project, a framework for carrying out guardianship will be created - i.e. a step-by-step guide to fulfilling different roles, both as an advisor, applicant and performer.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on Tallinna linna eestkostetavatele, kes viibivad Tallinnas, pakkuda nende vajadustele vastavaid sotsiaal- ja muid valdkonna teenuseid, mis aitavad neil iseseisvamalt toime tulla edaspidi nende autonoomiat vähem riivaval viisil. Projekti jooksul selginevad eestkoste piirid ja antakse sisendit sotsiaalteenuste arendamiseks. Projekti tulemusel tekib eestkoste teostamise raamistik - ehk etapiline juhend erinevate rollide täitmiseks, nii nõustaja, taotleja kui ka teostajana.

The platform connects clothing manufacturers and consumers through advertisements and makes it easier to find, compare and buy sustainable clothing. Operation_Summary_English: As a result of the project, an engineering solution of a biowaste composter with a delivery tape will be completed, which will enable the composting process to be carried out quickly and efficiently. An autonomous small-household composter helps convert bio-waste into high-quality soil. The solution created is particularly suitable in regions where it is difficult to organise central bio-waste collection.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti tulemusena valmib väljastuslindiga biojäätmete kompostri insenertehniline lahendus, mis võimaldab kiirelt ja efektiivselt kompostimisprotsessi läbi viia. Loodav lahendus on eriti sobilik piikondades, kus on keeruline korraldada tsentraalset biojäätmete kogumist.

Operation_Name_English: Video shoot master class for young people

Overall, the project aims to nurture a new generation of active citizens who are able to apply their skills and knowledge to create positive change in society and the environment.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of a competence centre in Viljandi County for the provision of services to children with special needs and their families
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Erivajadustega lastele ja nende peredele teenuste osutamiseks kompetentsikeskuse loomine Viljandimaale

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to reduce the availability and quality of public services for children with special needs and their families in Viljandi county . To achieve this, a competence centre will be established for the provision of services to children with special needs and their families on the basis of the Family Home Foundation in Viljandi rural municipality. In order to develop the service, it is necessary to build a new main building for the Family Home, which meets the modern requirements of energy efficiency, universal design and provision of social services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on p arandada erivajadustega lastele ja nende peredele suunatud avalike teenuste kättesaadavust ja kvaliteeti Viljandi maakonnas . Selle saavutamiseks rajatakse Viljandi valda SA Perekodu baasil erivajadustega lastele ja nende peredele teenuste osutamiseks kompetentsikeskus. Teenuse arendamiseks on vajalik Perekodule uue peahoone rajamine, mis vastab tänapäevastele energiatõhususe, universaalse disaini ja sotsiaalteenuste osutamise nõuetele.

The task of the expert is to identify the scalability and business development potential of the technological solution to be tested in the course of the project, as well as the potential for the emergence of possible spin-offs, as well as to advise demo project teams in the commercial implementation of the technological solution. The project will contribute to increasing the competences of the university's business cooperation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti käigus palgatakse AIRE demoprojektide äriarenduse ekspert, kelle ülesanne on toetada ülikooli teadlaseid teadmussiirde ja ettevõtluskompetentside arendamisel. Eksperdi ülesanne on tuvastada projekti käigus testitava tehnoloogilise lahenduse skaleeritavuse ja äriarenduse, samuti võimalike hargettevõtete tekkimise potentsiaal, aga ka nõustada demoprojektide meeskondi tehnoloogilise lahenduse ärilises rakendamises. Projekt aitab kaasa ülikooli ettevõtluskoostöö kompetentside tõstmisele.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti tulemusena töötatakse välja meetod infrapunaspektrist saadavate andmete sidumiseks puidu või puittoote omadustega ja luuakse digitaalne lahendus infrapunaspektrite ja puidu või puittoote omaduste sidumiseks (vastavuskataloog), mis võimaldab meetodi rakendamise asukohas teostatava kalibreerimise tulemusel jälgida ja juhtida spektris ilmnevate muutuste mõõtmise teel puidu või puittoote töötlemise või tootmise protsessi reaalajas.

Kogu tegevus toimub keskkonnasõbralikult – ilma heitgaasideta, toetades kestlikku eluviisi ja kogukonnatunnet. EcoQuest aitab tuua rohepöörde inimestele lähemale lõbusal ja kaasaval viisil.

In this way, the new fireplace installed is an opportunity to improve the living environment and to manage the household's heating supply significantly more economically. The aim of the project is to create a heating system, including the installation of an air-water heating device (A+++), as a result of which it is possible to optimize the heating needs of the building, which significantly reduces the energy consumption and reduces the carbon dioxide and fine particles generated by combustion in densely populated areas.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the doctoral project is to study novel ways of managing radioactive waste and to develop a cost-effective waste management strategy for small countries interested in small modular reactors, whose waste streams are significantly smaller than those of large countries. The methodology and tools developed for the development of the waste management strategy are also applied to the development of the existing historical radioactive waste management strategy, which in its volume does not justify the establishment of a full-scale industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Doktoriprojekti eesmärgiks on uurida radioaktiivsete jäätmete uudseid käitlusviise ning arendada kuluefektiivne jäätmekäitlusstrateegia väikemoodulreaktoritest huvitatud väikeriikidele, kelle jäätmevood on suurriikidest oluliselt väiksemad. Jäätmekäitlusstrateegia väljaarendamiseks loodud metoodikat ja töövahendeid rakendatakse ka olemasolevate ajalooliste radioaktiivsete jäätmete käitlemise strateegia väljaarendamisel, mis oma mahult ei õigusta täiemahulise tööstuse rajamist.

Operation_Name_English: Linking the Lagedi centre and train stops to cycling and walking infrastructure

Better connections to public transport and access to workplaces and services have been created through the missing footpath, bicycle path and the construction of two bicycle parking spaces. The share of people travelling by public transport, bicycle or foot is increasing significantly. Human behaviour will become more sustainable and less costly depending on environmental conditions.

Puuduoleva jalg- ja jalgrattatee ja kahe jalgrattaparkla rajamise kaudu on loodud paremad ühendused ühistranspordini ning jõudmine töökohtadele ja teenusteni. Operation_Name_English: Research-based youth work in Järvamaa

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Järvamaa noorsootöö kogub sisendeid konkreetselt oma maakonna noorte sihtgruppide (vanuses 13-15, 16-18 ja 19-26) kohta, et arendada valdkonda rohkem atraktiivseks ja sihtgruppi kaasavamaks. Operation_Name_English: Acquisition of an air-to-water heat pump with installation VALVA 46 TÕRVA

Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The existing heating system, based on a wooden boiler, is outdated and inefficient, requiring continuous manual heating and fuel acquisition and storage. In addition, it leads to a higher environmental impact as the burning of wood emits carbon dioxide and other pollutants into the air. The project aims to replace this old heating system with a modern air-to-water heat pump, which is more convenient and energy efficient. The new solution will contribute to a cleaner and more sustainable environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Olemasolev küttesüsteem, mis põhineb puukatlal, on vananenud ja ebaefektiivne, nõudes pidevat käsitsi kütmist ning kütuse hankimist ja ladustamist. Lisaks tekitab see suuremat keskkonnamõju, kuna puidu põletamine paiskab õhku süsinikdioksiidi ja muid saasteaineid. Projekti eesmärk on asendada see vana küttesüsteem kaasaegse õhk-vesi soojuspumbaga, mis on mugavam ja energiatõhusam. Uus lahendus aitab kaasa puhtama ja jätkusuutlikuma keskkonna loomisele.

Operation_Name_English: Development of youth work and integration of senior work with youth work in Jõgeva municipality

Mobile youth workers reach different parts of the municipality to deal with young people. The elderly are socially active and participate in various joint activities.

Mobiilse noorsootöö töötajad jõuavad valla eri paikadesse noortega tegelema. Eakad on ühiskondlikult aktiivsed ja osalevad erinevates ühistegevustes.

Operation_Name_English: Involvement of a top specialist to increase the competence in remote sensing in the field of EEC geodesy
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tippspetsialisti kaasamine EMÜ geodeesia valdkonna kaugseire alase kompetentsi tõstmiseks
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project develops the competence of Geodetic Remote Sensing (InSAR) at the Estonian University of Life Sciences in order to improve the Earth's deformation models and the Estonian geodetic reference framework. A top specialist working on satellite data analysis and integration of GNSS and levelling data will be involved. As a result of the project, the level of research and competitiveness of the university will improve, a new learning competence will be created and cooperation with international partners will be strengthened.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt arendab Eesti Maaülikoolis geodeetilise kaugseire (InSAR) kompetentsi, et täiustada maapinna deformatsioonimudeleid ja Eesti geodeetilist referentsraamistikku. Kaasatakse tippspetsialist, kes töötab satelliitandmete analüüsi ning GNSS- ja nivelleerimisandmete integreerimisega. Projekti tulemusel paraneb ülikooli teadustöö tase ja konkurentsivõime, tekib uus õppekompetents ja tugevneb koostöö rahvusvaheliste partneritega.

Operation_Name_English: Mechanisms of action of innovative antibacterial dressing
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Nanordica Medical is an Estonian research and development company that specializes in the development of new, more effective wound treatment products based on nanotechnology. The aim of the project is applied research, which investigates the mechanisms of action of wound dressings. As a result of the study, information is generated on how the various components of nanotechnology developed by the company affect the process of wound healing. It forms the basis for the supply of an existing product and the development of new products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nanordica Medical on Eesti teadus- ja arendusettevõte, mis on spetsialiseerunud uute, efektiivsemate, nanotehnoloogial põhinevate haavaravitoodete väljatöötamisele. Projekti eesmärgiks on rakendusuuring, mille käigus uuritakse haavasidemete toimemehhanisme. Uuringu tulemusena tekib teave, kuidas ettevõtte poolt väljatöötatud nanotehnoloogia erinevad komponendid mõjutavad haavaparanemise protsessile. See on aluseks olemasoleva toote v ää rtuspakkumise t õ stmiseks ja uute toodete arendamiseks.

The aim is to support local governments in complying with the ‘Requirements for Home Services’ Regulation, which entered into force in 2025, using the innovative platform of CareMate OÜ. In the course of the project, a user module for local governments will be developed in cooperation with Rõuge Rural Municipality Government.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Iseseisev elu hooleandja toel“ parandab koduteenuse kvaliteeti ja kättesaadavust, et tagada eakatele ja erivajadustega inimestele väärikas elu kodus. Eesmärk on toetada kohalikke omavalitsusi 2025. aastal jõustunud „Nõuded koduteenustele“ määruse täitmisel, kasutades CareMate OÜ innovaatilist platvormi. Projekti käigus arendatakse koostöös Rõuge Vallavalitsusega platvormile KOVidele mõeldud kasutusmoodul.

Operation_Name_English: PT Altum OÜ fire cannon targeting algorithm development with mechatronic control system

Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the company is to develop and bring to the world market a firefighting ejector based on a novel and unique eddy current technology, with the help of which it would be possible to discharge either liquid or powdered charges with a mass of 10-20 kg into the fireplace from a distance of about 80-10 m. This project will develop and test an anti-cannon targeting algorithm, which should be able to calculate the initial firing angle and direction for the identified target.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ettevõtte eesmärgiks on arendada välja ja viia maailmaturule uudsel ja unikaalsel pöörisvootehnoloogial põhinev tuletõrje paiskeseade, mille abil oleks võimalik paisata kas vedelikku või pulbrilist laengut massiga 10 - 20 kg tulekahjukoldesse ca 80-10 m kauguselt. Käesoleva projekti raames arendatakse välja ja katsetatakse tõrjekahuri sihtimisalgoritm, mis peaks suutma tuvastatud sihtmärgile arvutama esialgse laskenurga ja suuna.

During one week, various environmental activities will take place in the camp. The aim of the camp is to raise the environmental awareness of local young people and help them understand how they can make their everyday life more environmentally friendly in order to support Ida-Virumaa's transition to a climate-neutral economy.

Ühe nädala jooksul toimuvad laagris erinevad keskkonnateemalised tegevused. Laagri eesmärgiks on tõsta kohaliku noorte keskkonnateadlikkust ja aidata neil mõista, kuidas nad saavad oma igapäevaelu keskkonnasõbralikumaks muuta, et toetada Ida-Virumaa üleminekut kliimaneutraalsele majandusele.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the doctoral project is to develop a methodology for estimating forest height and volume in hemiboral forests from bistatic artificial aperture radar data, mainly using the TanDEM-X mission. Töö käigus luuakse kaasaegne metoodika ja masinõppemudel metsa kõrguse ja mahu tuvastamiseks. Saadud tulemust võrreldakse lennuki LiDAR-mõõdistuste ja maapealsete mõõtmistega.
