Projekti tulemusena väheneb lokaalsete saasteallikate arv Võru linnas ning Võru kaugküttevõrk muutub efektiivsemaks.

Operation_Name_English: Installation of air-to-water heat pumps and radiators for Suur-Lossi 6 private houses
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Suur-Lossi 6 eramule õhk-vesi soojuspumba ja radioaatorite paigaldamine
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: A hk-water heat pump and radiators are installed in Suur-Lossi 6 private house to better ensure a suitable indoor temperature for living in the building.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Suur-Lossi 6 eramule paigaldatakse õ hk-vesi soojuspump ja radiaatorid, et paremini tagada hoones elamiseks sobiv sisetemperatuur.

Operation_Name_English: Installing a new oven instead of an old one
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uue ahju paigaldus vana ahju asemele
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The construction of a new furnace in place of the old broken furnace will allow to normalize the indoor temperature of the residential building to be habitable, save heating costs and improve the air quality of densely populated areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Vana katkise ahju asemele uue ahju ehitamine võimaldab normaliseerida eluhoone sisetemperatuuri elamiskõlbulikuks, kokku hoida küttekulusid ja parandada tiheasustuse õhukvaliteeti.

Operation_Name_English: Creation and development of learning environments suitable for young people in Põltsamaa rural municipality HEV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Põltsamaa valla HEV noortele sobivate õpikeskkondade loomine ja arendamine
Category_Label: Infrastructure for primary and secondary education
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to create suitable learning environments for HEV students in Põltsamaa rural municipality, furnishing existing rooms for therapy and forest rooms, and creating special sitting places. These spaces allow professionals to provide the necessary therapies and support HEV students' smooth integration into mainstream learning and social life. As a result of the project, HEV will improve the availability and quality of services for students, contributing to the implementation of the principles of inclusive education in Põltsamaa.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Eesmärk on luua Põltsamaa vallas HEV õpilastele sobivad õpikeskkonnad, sisustades olemasolevad ruumid teraapia- ja metsatoaks ning luua spetsiaalsed istumiskohad. Need ruumid võimaldavad spetsialistidel pakkuda vajalikke teraapiaid ning toetavad HEV õpilaste sujuvat integreerumist tavaõppesse ja sotsiaalsesse ellu. Projekti tulemusena paraneb HEV õpilastele suunatud teenuste kättesaadavus ja kvaliteet, aidates kaasa kaasava hariduse põhimõtete rakendamisele Põltsamaa vallas.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the accessibility of public services in Põlva municipality
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Avalike teenuste ligipääsetavuse parandamine Põlva vallas
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure the comprehensive accessibility of public services in Põlva rural municipality to all residents of the rural municipality, but above all, the target group is elderly people and people with temporary or permanent special needs who currently (in 2023) do not have sufficient access to public services. The project activities will improve the digital accessibility of the Põlva rural municipality website, develop existing e-services and build an accessible rural municipality building.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks on Põlva valla avalike teenuste tervikliku ligipääsetavuse tagamine kõigile valla elanikele, kuid eelkõige on sihtrühmaks eakad ja ajutise või püsiva erivajadusega inimesed, kellele käesoleval ajal (2023. aastal) ei ole avalikud teenused piisavalt kättesaadavad. Projekti tegevustega parandatakse Põlva valla kodulehekülje digiligipääsetavust, arendatakse olemasolevaid e-teenuseid ja rajatakse ligipääsetav vallamaja.

Operation_Name_English: Acquisition of metal processing equipment of NikSteel OÜ
Category_Label: Innovation processes in SMEs (process, organisational, marketing, co-creation, user and demand driven innovation)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the volume of metal processing services and the share of exports to the Nordic countries. This goal can be achieved thanks to the fleet of machines to be acquired and the team to be created.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on suurendada metallitöötlemise teenuste mahtu ning ekspordi osakaalu Põhjamaadesse. Antud eesmärk on saavutatav tänu soetatavale masinapargile ja loodavale meeskonnale.

Operation_Name_English: Protection of intellectual property of Vectiopep OÜ
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Biotechnology company Vectiopep OÜ develops mRNA-based drug delivery technology. Our goal is to be a global leader in this field, defending our innovations with patents and collaborating with major pharmaceutical companies. The project will help us expand the global protection of the company's intellectual property, build trust and ensure a competitive advantage.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Biotehnoloogia ettevõte Vectiopep OÜ arendab mRNA põhiste ravimite kohaletoimetamise tehnoloogiat. Meie eesmärk on olla ülemaailmne liider selles valdkonnas, kaitstes oma uuendusi patentidega ja tehes koostööd suurte farmaatsiaettevõtetega. Projekt aitab meil laiendada ettevõtte intellektuaalomandi ülemaailmset kaitset, luua usaldust ja tagada konkurentsieelis.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of heating equipment at Tuisu 15, Rakvere
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: As a result of the project, the heating system of the whole building will be modernised and renewed. As a result, the heating system will become much more environmentally friendly and modern. This means abandoning the depreciated solid fuel heater and replacing it with a modern environmentally friendly solution, air-to-water heat pump and radiator system. As a result, we can significantly improve the air quality in the surrounding area.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti läbiviimise tulemusena saab kogu hoone küttesüsteem kaasajastatud ning uuendatud. Seeläbi muutub küttesüsteem omakorda palju keskkonnasõbralikumaks ning kaasaegsemaks. See tähendab siis loobumist tahkel kütusel toimivast amortiseerunud kütteseadmest ning asendades see siis kaasaegse keskkonnasõbraliku lahendusega, õhk-vesi soojuspumba ning radiaatorisüsteemiga. Selle tulemusena saame parandada märkimisväärselt ümbritseva elupiirkonna õhukvaliteeti.

Operation_Name_English: Innovation component Language learning platform
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop a minimum working prototype (MVP) of the Duotale platform that allows children to listen to fairy tales in two languages sequentially, in both their mother tongue and the language they are learning. The solution uses Automated Text-to-Speech (TTS) technology to create multilingual and emotionally enriched audio content. As a result of the project, the web-based prototype to be tested will be completed together with samples of the stories entered, which are ready for scaling to other language pairs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on arendada välja Duotale platvormi minimaalne töötav prototüüp (MVP), mis võimaldab lastel kuulata muinasjutte kahes keeles järjestikku – nii emakeeles kui ka õpitavas keeles. Lahendus kasutab automatiseeritud tekstist kõneks tehnoloogiat (TTS), et luua mitmekeelne ja emotsioonidega rikastatud heli sisu. Projekti tulemusena valmib testitav veebipõhine prototüüp koos sisestatud lugude näidistega, millel on valmidus skaleerimiseks teistele keelepaaridele.

Operation_Name_English: Piiri 26 , Otepää, furnace refurbishment
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: As a result of the project, once again a dignified old individual dwelling has received a new heart, i.e. a new stove. This has improved the air quality in the surrounding area and the health of our closest and farther neighbours, as the air is cleaner. Thanks to the efficient combustion process in new furnaces, a lot of firewood is not brought out of the forest every year, and a lot of carbon is not emitted into the air.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti tulemusel on taaskord üks väärikas vana individuaalelamu saanud endale uue südame ehk uue ahju. Sellega on paranenud ümbruskonna õhukvaliteet ja nii lähimate kui ka kaugemate naabrite tervis kuna õhk on puhtam. Tänu efektiivsele põlemisprotsessile uutes ahjudes jääb iga aastal metsast toomata hulk küttepuid ning õhku paiskamata hulk süsinikku.

Operation_Name_English: Survey of population satisfaction in the city and municipality of Rakvere
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Elanike rahulolu uuring läbiviimine Rakvere linnas ja vallas
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The city and municipality of Rakvere wish to jointly conduct a satisfaction survey of the residents of Rakvere. The aim of the population satisfaction survey is to collect feedback on residents' expectations, needs and assessments in order to improve local services, improve the quality of the living environment and support informed decision-making in planning the development of the region.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rakvere linn ja vald soovivad ühiselt läbi viija elanike rahulolu-uuringu. Elanike rahulolu-uuringu eesmärk on koguda tagasisidet elanike ootuste, vajaduste ja hinnangute kohta, et parandada kohalikke teenuseid, tõsta elukeskkonna kvaliteeti ja toetada teadlikku otsuste tegemist piirkonna arengu kavandamisel.

Operation_Name_English: Developing an innovative assessment methodology for the adaptation of the visual system to XR environments
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uuendusliku hindamismetoodika välja töötamine nägemissüsteemi kohanemiseks XR-keskkondade kasutamisel
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Despite the significant increase in the use of extended reality (XR) environments, it is not known how the human visual system adapts to them. The aim of the project is to develop a methodology for assessing the adaptation of the user to XR environments. The results will help develop solutions for the safe integration of XR technologies into areas such as health and defence, reducing health risks and ensuring effective performance.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Hoolimata märkimisväärsest tõusust laiendatud reaalsuse (XR) keskkondade kasutamisel, ei ole teada kuidas inimese nägemissüsteem nendega kohaneb. Projekti eesmärgiks on arendada välja metoodika kasutaja XR keskkondadega kohanemise hindamiseks. Tulemused aitavad välja töötada lahendusi XR-tehnoloogiate turvaliseks integreerimiseks valdkondadesse nagu tervishoid ja kaitsevaldkond, vähendades terviseriske ja tagades efektiivse töövõime.

Operation_Name_English: Biogas tests
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: In the course of the project, tests with biochar will be carried out in order to understand in what proportion and during what period of time biogas must be added to the biogas raw material in order for biogas production to become as efficient as possible. Considering that biogas is a non-fossil fuel, its calorific value is relatively high and it can be produced from existing raw materials in Estonia, biogas has broad perspectives as a fuel used for different purposes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti käigus teostatakse katsetused biosöega selleks, et aru saada millises vahekorras ja millise aja jooksul tuleb biposütt biogaasi toormaterjalile lisada selleks, et biogaasi tootmine muutuks võimalikult efektiivseks. Arvestades, et biogaas on mittefossiilne kütus, tema kütteväärtus on suhteliselt kõrge ja seda on võimalik toota Eestis olemasolevast toormest, on biogaasil erineval otstarbel kasutatava kütusena laiad perspektiivid.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of Laulasmaa-Lohusalu bicycle and footpath
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: In Laulasmaa, Lääne-Harju rural municipality, a 2.0-2.5 m wide and 1.45 km long bicycle and footpath will be built from Laulasmaa to Lohusalu, which will make access to services easier, improve the safe route for the population to work, school, public services and trade. It will be safer for local residents and visitors, as well as for people with special needs, by providing them with safer mobility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Lääne-Harju vallas Laulasmaal rajatakse Laulasmaa–Lohusalu 2,0-2,5 m laiune ja 1,45 km pikkune jalgratta- ja jalgtee, mis muudab teenustele ligipääsu lihtsamaks, parendab elanikkonnale turvalise teekonna tööle, kooli, avalikele teenustele ja kaubandusele. Liiklemine muutub ohutumaks nii kohalikele elanikele ja külastajatele ning ka erivajadustega inimestele tagades neile turvalisema liikumiskeskkonna.

Operation_Summary_English: In the course of the Steed development project, an easy-to-attach, wearable, biometric device is created for the horse to monitor the health indicators of the animal. During the project, the first version of the product's mechanics, electronics and firmware will be developed and prototyped. As a result of the project, a functional prototype complying with the requirements of TRL 5 will be completed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Steed arendusprojekti käigus luuakse hobusele lihtsalt kinnitatav, kantav, biomeetriline seade looma tervisenäitajate jälgimiseks. Projekti käigus arendatakse ja prototüübidakse toote mehhanika, elektroonika ja püsivara esimene versioon. Projekti tulemusena valmib TRL 5 nõuetele vastava toimiv prototüüp.

Operation_Name_English: NORF'24
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: NORF'24 is a rap festival for young people, taking place on the Iisaku Song Stage on 24.08.2023. All young rap enthusiasts aged 12-22 from all over Estonia are invited to apply for the festival stage with their own creations. In addition to young people, well-known Estonian rap artists will perform on the festival stage. The aim of the festival is to promote rap culture among young people, encourage young people's own initiative, unite young people of different ages and nationalities for a common goal. NORF is a launch platform that gives young people a new outlet!
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: NORF'24 on noorte oma räpifestival, mis leiab aset 24.08.2023 Iisaku laululaval. Festivali lavale oodatakse omaloominguga kandideerima kõiki noori räpihuvilisi üle Eesti vanuses 12-22aastat. Lisaks noortele astuvad festivali laval üles ka teada-tuntud Eesti räpiartistid. Festivali eesmärk on propageerida noorte seas räpikultuuri, julgustada noorte omaalgatuslikku tegevust, ühendada eri vanuses ja rahvuses noori ühtse eesmärgi nimel. NORF on stardiplatvorm, mis annab noortele uue väljundi!

Operation_Name_English: Pärnu County Design Department

The support services of creative entrepreneurs and the development programme that focuses on the role of design in product development are aimed at developing the design department of Pärnu County, growing the community of entrepreneurs interested in design in Pärnu County, and increasing the design awareness of entrepreneurs.

Loomeettevõtjate tugiteenused ja disaini rolli tootearenduses tähtsustav arenguprogramm on suunatud Pärnumaa disainiKOBARa arendamiseks, disainihuviliste Pärnumaa ettevõtjate kogukonna kasvatamiseks ning ettevõtjate disainiteadlikkuse suurendamiseks.

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure a smoother transition to the green transition for the inhabitants of Ida-Viru County, increase their environmental awareness and change their attitude towards innovation. The project's activities include conducting trainings and workshops on environmental issues, conducting research related to the region's cultural heritage and aimed at preserving the environment, and creating and performing educational productions based on the results.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks tagada Ida-Virumaa elanike sujuvam üleminek rohepöördele, tõsta nende keskkonnateadlikkust ja muuta nende suhtumist uuendustesse. Operation_Summary_English: In order to develop the digital database that manages Pärt's archives, the Arvo Pärt Centre is sending an archive specialist to the University of Tartu for doctoral studies. Kristina Kõrver's doctoral thesis "Arvo Pärt's manuscripts as an internal speech in sound, word and picture: analysis of the textological specificities of the composer’s creative process’ applies innovative research methods (intersemiotic analysis, internal speech theory) and examines Pärt’s creative process as a whole and through case studies. As a result of the research, the digital database will be expanded and the user experience will be improved.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pärdi arhiivi haldava digiandmebaasi arendamiseks lähetab Arvo Pärdi Keskus Tartu Ülikooli doktorantuuri arhiivispetsialisti. Kristina Kõrveri doktoritöö „Arvo Pärdi käsikirjad kui sisekõne helis, sõnas ja pildis: helilooja loomeprotsessi tekstoloogilise eripära analüüs“ rakendab innovatiivseid uurimismeetodeid (intersemiootiline analüüs, sisekõne-teooria) ning uurib Pärdi loomeprotsessi tervikuna ja juhtumiuuringute kaudu. Teadustöö tulemusel täieneb digiandmebaas ja paraneb kasutajakogemus.

Operation_Name_English: SOFTacademy
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to develop and demonstrate a collaborative renovation model for urban governments to accelerate private renovation. It proposes a model in which the neighbourhoods are co-created using "prefabricated elements” for both buildings and space in between them. This would allow to transform the outdoor according to shared values and support future-proof homes that respond also to the aims of carbon neutrality, circularity, accessibility, affordability and liveability. The project will develop the "hardware" (physical space elements, devices) and "software" (governance, technologies, models) and a toolset aimed to facilitate the work of a new urban service developed for Tallinn City, which will sustain the future implementation of the solution. For the demonstration of the solution, the project pre-engaged a neighbourhood of four five-storey buildings. For the demonstration of the model, the project foresees to blend funding of the SOFTacademy with state-paid subsidies and ongoing innovation projects (H2020).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärk on töötada välja ja tutvustada linnavalitsuste ühist renoveerimismudelit, et kiirendada erasektori renoveerimist. Selles pakutakse välja mudel, mille kohaselt luuakse naabruskonnad koos, kasutades nii hoonete kui ka nendevahelise ruumi jaoks kokkupandavaid elemente. See võimaldaks muuta väliskeskkonda vastavalt ühistele väärtustele ja toetada tulevikukindlaid kodusid, mis vastavad ka CO2-neutraalsuse, ringluse, juurdepääsetavuse, taskukohasuse ja elamiskõlblikkuse eesmärkidele. Projekti raames töötatakse välja "riistvara" (füüsilised ruumielemendid, seadmed) ja "tarkvara" (juhtimine, tehnoloogiad, mudelid) ning tööriistakomplekt, mille eesmärk on hõlbustada Tallinna linna jaoks välja töötatud uue linnateenuse tööd, mis toetab lahenduse edasist rakendamist. Lahenduse tutvustamiseks eelnes projektile neljast viiekorruselisest hoonest koosnev naabruskond. Mudeli tutvustamiseks on projektiga ette nähtud ühendada SOFTakadeemia rahastamine riigi makstud toetuste ja käimasolevate innovatsiooniprojektidega (Horisont 2020).

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to establish dwellings for the provision of housing services to people with less need for assistance and support in Kadrina rural municipality, in order to prevent the current people from going to an institution where the general care service provided outside the home is provided. As a result, Kadrina Service House has been built in the centre of attraction of the municipality of Kadrina, where people with less need for help and support have access to social and health services, essential goods and from where it is very easy to get to the services.

Uus PMS võimaldab meil integreerida teisi süsteeme. Võtame kasutusse automaatse hinnastamise lahenduse.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the heating unit in the city of Pärnu Suur-Sepa 4-5
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures
Operation_Summary_English: The block of a terraced house needs to be connected to district heating, as the existing heating solutions are inefficient and exhausted. The four-storey terraced house can only be heated by a small fireplace and air heat pumps during the winter period. The family together with two small children have to live in the basement floor most of the time during the cold period, which is actually the hallway of the sauna. The use of air heat pumps turns out to be too expensive and the family does not have this resource. Connecting to district heating is extremely necessary for the use of a residential building.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ridaelamu boks vajab kaugkütega liitumist, kuna olemasolevad küttelahendused on ebaefektiivsed ja ammendunud. Nelja korruseline ridaelamu on talveperioodil köetav vaid väikese kamina ja õhksoojuspumpade abil. Pererahvas koos kahe väikese lapsega peab külmal perioodil elama enamus ajast keldrikorrusel, mis on tegelikult sauna eesruum. Õhksoojuspumpade kasutamine osutub liiga kalliks ja seda ressursi perel pole. Kaugküttega liitumine on äärmiselt vajalik elamu kasutamiseks.

Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Ringy is implementing a project that will result in the development of a new SaaS, which is a web software for buy-back processes that allows companies marketing electronics to automate the processes involved in providing a buy-back service and thereby simplify and scale the provision of the service to their end customer. The aim of the development of the service is to reduce the amount of equipment that turns into electronic waste and to minimise the environmental damage caused by the production of new equipment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ringy viib ellu projekti, mille tulemusel arendatakse välja uus SaaS, mis on tagasiostu protsesside veebitarkvara, mis võimaldab elektroonikat turustavatel ettevõtetel tagasiostu teenuse pakkumisega seotud protsesse automatiseerida ning teenuse pakkumist oma lõppkliendile selle abil lihtsustada ja skaleerida. Teenuse arendamise eesmärk on vähendada elektroonikajäätmeteks pöörduvate seadmete hulka ning minimeerida uute seadmete tootmisest tingitud keskkonnakahju.

Operation_Name_English: Green Survival Camp
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: Environmentally oriented survival camp for young people in Ida-Viru County. The participants live in Toila municipality, which is known for its excellent beasty and seaside nature. In the camp, they acquire survival skills, learn the principles of sustainable development and participate in deforestation and other environmental initiatives. The camp helps young people to get to know the nature of the area better and learn to care for nature.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Keskkonnale orienteeritud ellujäämislaager noortele Ida-Virumaal. Osalejad elavad Toila omavalitsuses, mis on tuntud oma suurepärase metsalise ja mereäärse looduse poolest. Laagris omandavad nad ellujäämisoskusi, õpivad jätkusuutliku arengu põhimõtteid ning osalevad metsade raiumises ja teistes keskkonnaalgatustes. Laager aitab noortel paremini tundma õppida piirkonna loodust ja õppida loodust hoolivalt hoidma.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of a system for improving the quality of catering services in municipal schools and promoting food education

Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The Association of Tartu County Municipalities has set the goal of supporting the mental and physical health of pupils in schools managed by local governments by increasing the quality of catering management services and systematically promoting food education. To this end, a development programme "School Family Food Wisdom!" will be developed. The development programme will be piloted in five county schools and developed and expanded in the county. Representatives of schools participating in the programme participate in study visits in Lithuania and Finland.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tartumaa Omavalitsuste Liit on seadnud sihiks omavalitsuste poolt hallatavates koolides toetada õpilaste vaimset ja füüsilist tervist toitlustuskorralduse teenuse kvaliteedi tõstmise ja toiduhariduse süsteemse edendamise kaudu. Selleks töötatakse välja arenguprogramm "Koolipere toidutargaks!". Arenguprogrammi piloteeritakse viies maakonna koolis ning arendatakse ja laiendatakse maakonnas. Programmis osalevate koolide esindajad osalevad õppevisiitidel Leedus ja Soomes.

Operation_Name_English: Werroform OÜ launches modern and efficient Smart Brick production line
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Werroform OÜ kaasaegse ja tõhusa Smart Brick tootmisliini käivitamine
Category_Label: Innovation processes in SMEs (process, organisational, marketing, co-creation, user and demand driven innovation)
Operation_Summary_English: A modern company enhances wood on an automated production line. Werroform OÜ has been producing prefabricated wooden house elements and details for about 15 years and has developed its own sales channels mainly in Central Europe. Currently, the Võru factory mainly exports its products, but this year SmartBrick will be brought to the Estonian market because these wooden building blocks offer a quick and easy way to build both in urban conditions and in less accessible construction sites.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Modernne ettevõte väärindab puitu automatiseeritud tootmisliinil. Werroform OÜ on eelvalmistatud puitmajade elemente ja detaile tootnud ca 15 aastat ja välja on kujunenud oma müügikanalid peamiselt Kesk-Euroopas. Hetkel Võru tehas valdavalt ekspordib oma tooteid, aga käesoleval aastal tuuakse SmartBrick Eesti turule, sest on need puitehitusplokid pakuvad kiiret ja lihtsat ehitamisvõimalust nii linnatingimustes, kui raskemini juurdepääsetavates ehituspaikades.

Operation_Name_English: Mental Pin Software Development
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Mental Pin is a portable data collection device that helps people cope with anxiety and OCDs and get relief from symptoms. We help our users understand emotional and physiological patterns and give them full control over their mental health data. The aim of the project is to develop a part of the product with a specific connection and corresponding to the designs of the owner. As a result of the project, we want to test the full journey of the product on our users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Mental Pin on kaasaskantav andmekogumise funktsiooniga seade, mis aitab inimestel ärevuse ja OCD-dega toime tulla ja saada leevendust sümptomitele. Aitame oma kasutajatel mõista emotsionaalseid ja füsioloogilisi mustreid ning anname neile täieliku kontrolli oma vaimse tervise andmete üle. Projekti eesmärk on välja arendada kindla ühendusega ja omaniku disainidele vastav tarkvara osa tootest. Projekti lõpptulemusena soovime toote täis teekonda testida meie kasutajatel.

Operation_Name_English: theOthers AI
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: This project is designed to help users find lost Bitcoins using artificial intelligence and blockchain cross-chain technology. Over 6 million Bitcoins have been lost globally, forming a large number of ‘silent assets’. Through theOthers.io platform, we can help owners confirm and restore these assets, and at the same time allow ordinary users to claim orphan Bitcoins, thereby activating dormant assets and providing new value to the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: See projekt on loodud selleks, et aidata kasutajatel tehisintellekti ja plokiahela ristkettide tehnoloogia abil leida kadunud Bitcoine. Ülemaailmselt on kaotatud üle 6 miljoni Bitcoini, mis moodustab suure hulga „vaikivat vara”. theOthers.io platvormi kaudu saame aidata omanikel neid varasid kinnitada ja taastada ning samal ajal lubada tavakasutajatel nõuda omanikuta Bitcoine, aktiveerides seeläbi uinunud vara ja pakkudes turule uut väärtus.

Operation_Name_English: Aidu quarry disc golf park
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The disc golf park at Aidu quarry brings recreational activities that improve the living environment to Ida-Viru County. The project promotes healthy lifestyles, strengthens community cohesion and revitalizes the local economy by integrating nature education and environmental awareness. Disc golf park offers attractive, accessible and environmentally friendly activities for both locals and tourists, supporting the transition of the region to a climate-neutral economy.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Aidu karjääri discgolfipark toob Ida-Virumaale elukeskkonda parandavaid vabaajategevusi. Projekt edendab tervislikke eluviise, tugevdab kogukonna sidusust ja elavdab kohalikku majandust integreerides loodushariduse ja keskkonnateadlikkuse. Discgolfipark pakub nii kohalikele kui ka turistidele atraktiivset, ligipääsetavat ja keskkonnasõbralikku tegevust, mis toetab piirkonna üleminekut kliimaneutraalsele majandusele.

Operation_Name_English: The Garden of the Kreenholm Community
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The Kreenholm community garden plans to build a beautiful and functional greenhouse to make the work of the garden more easily accessible and open. In the summer, the greenhouse helps to keep the seedlings warm, provides shelter from rain and allows the tools to be kept handy. A rainwater collection and a small exhibition area are planned. Volunteers, architecture students of the Estonian Academy of Arts and local residents will be involved in the construction of the greenhouse. There are also plans to organise lectures and events.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kreenholmi kogukonnaaed plaanib ehitada kauni ja funktsionaalse kasvuhoone, et muuta aia töö rohkem kergesti ligipääsetavaks ja avatud. Suvel aitab kasvuhoone hoida seemikud soojas, pakub varju vihma eest ja võimaldab tööriistade hoidmist käepäraselt. Planeeritud on vihmavee kogumine ja väike näituseala. Kasvuhoone ehitusse kaasatakse vabatahtlikud, Eesti Kunstiakadeemia arhitektuuritudengid ja kohalikud elanikud. Samuti on plaanis korraldada loenguid ja üritusi.

Operation_Name_English: Reliable sensor analysis system

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the RAPID sensors developed in TalTech and make them more fault-tolerant and user-friendly. Sensors help to understand the physical conditions fish are exposed to in hydropower plants and reduce the need to experiment with live fish. The project creates a simple computer program that allows you to check the condition of the sensors in just a few seconds. The results will help make future sensor systems more durable and easier to use outdoors.

Operation_Summary_English: Carbon trade is part of the European Union's climate policy and a key tool for reducing greenhouse gas emissions in a cost-effective way. At the same time, the voluntary carbon market is opaque, leading to mistrust. The aim of the applied research is to develop the method of quantitative assessment of forest carbon stock based on remote sensing and the model used in the territory of Estonia will be completed. The results of the study can be applied to ensure landowners have access to the global carbon market and to accelerate the green transition.

Uuringu tulemusi saab rakendada tagamaks maaomanikele juurdepääsu globaalsele süsinikuturule ja kiirendamaks rohepööret.

To achieve the goal, a Roma support network will be created and a total of about 100 Roma will be developed and implemented for various activities, including work clubs, professional, Estonian language, computer, time management trainings, career and debt counselling.

Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services

As a result of the project, the amount of pollution load discharged into the environment will be reduced and the operating efficiency of the treatment plants will be improved. Improved quality of service for residents of waste water collection areas is also ensured.

Operation_Name_English: Development and testing of a volunteering prevention model as an additional component of home care services in four municipalities.

Operation_Summary_English: The essence is the integration of the service model of volunteer companions as a preventive activity as an additional component of home services provided by local governments. This makes it possible to provide additional support to both those in need and their loved ones. The service supports the long-term autonomy of the target group and improves the quality of mental and physical well-being. With the implementation of the service model, a community social network will be created in the local government, which will help to reduce the burden of social services of local governments.

See võimaldab pakkuda täiendavat tuge nii abivajajatele kui ka nende lähedastele. Teenus toetab sihtrühma pikemaajalist iseseisvust ja parandades vaimse- ja füüsilise heaolu kvaliteeti. Teenusmudeli rakendamisega luuakse omavalitsusse kogukondlik seltsiliste võrgustik, mis aitab vähendada omavalitsuste sotsiaalteenuste koormust.

Operation_Name_English: Complete reconstruction of apartment building at Laane 7, Kuusalu
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Korterelamu terviklik rekonstrueerimine aadressil Laane tn 7, Kuusalu
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation of existing housing stock, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the complete reconstruction of the apartment building Laane str 7. The purpose of the renovation is to increase the energy efficiency of the building, reduce heating costs and improve living conditions. Activities include insulating the facade and roof, renovating the heating system, and renovating the ventilation and electrical systems. The result is a greener and more energy-efficient residential building, leading to lower energy costs and a longer lifespan of the building
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt hõlmab korterelamu Laane tn 7 terviklikku rekonstrueerimist. Rekonstrueerimise eesmärk on suurendada hoone energiatõhusust, vähendada küttekulusid ning parandada elamistingimusi. Tegevuste hulka kuuluvad fassaadi ja katuse soojustamine, küttesüsteemi uuendamine ning ventilatsiooni ja elektrisüsteemide renoveerimine. Tulemuseks on keskkonnasäästlikum ja energiatõhusa elamu, mis toob kaasa väiksemad energiakulud ja pikema hoone eluea

Operation_Name_English: Transformation of Tõrva tavern building into a multifunctional entertainment and leisure centre

Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: With the support of the project, the public space in the centre of Tõrva will be further developed, as a result of which the Tõrva historical tavern building will be integrated into the public space of the central square and transformed into a multifunctional entertainment and leisure centre accessible to all user groups.

Operation_Name_English: Supporting children and families
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of TAT is to support that Estonia is a good place to start a family and raise children, and that Estonian children are happy, growing up in a caring, inclusive, safe and developing environment. The activities shall ensure equal opportunities for members of the target group of different genders, ages, regions and nationalities to participate in and benefit from the activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: TAT üldine eesmärk on toetada seda, et Eesti oleks hea paik pere loomiseks ja laste kasvatamiseks ning Eesti lapsed oleksid õnnelikud, kasvades hoolivas, kaasavas, turvalises ja arendavas keskkonnas. Tegevuste käigus tagatakse eri soost, vanusest, piirkonnast ja rahvusest sihtrühma liikmetele võrdsed võimalused tegevustes osaleda ja nendest kasu saada..

Operation_Name_English: Courier's cupboard 50: Generations of Dance
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the capacity of young people and support civic initiatives in Ida-Viru County - by celebrating the 50th anniversary of the dance collective Kullerkupp. The group has offered self-development opportunities to more than 600 young people. Activities bring together members of different generations and showcase cultural heritage to the community. The project will strengthen regional coherence and help adapt to the transition to a climate-neutral economy by providing meaningful opportunities for participation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti eesmärgiks on Ida-Virumaal noorte võime tõstmise ja kodanikualgatuste toetamise kaudu - tantsukollektiivi Kullerkupp 50. juubeliaasta tähistamise kaudu. Kollektiiv on pakkunud enam kui 600 noorele enesearenduse võimalusi. Tegevused ühendavad eri põlvkondade liikmeid ja tutvustavad kogukonnale kultuuripärandit. Projekt tugevdab piirkondlikku sidusust ja aitab kohaneda kliimaneutraalsele majandusele üleminekul, pakkudes tähenduslikke osalusvõimalusi.

We use environmentally friendly materials and want to increase our market share in Estonia and internationally. The project will help create jobs in the community and promote environmental sustainability in the toy industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Lavelly Disain OÜ toodab Võrumaal Montessori põhimõtetel põhinevaid arendavaid ja jätkusuutlikke tooteid lastele. Operation_Summary_English: Rapla municipality wishes to improve the availability and quality of support services offered to children at the beginning of their education. For this purpose, the centre of support services will be established at the Päkapikk kindergarten in Rapla city, which will coordinate and organise the organisation of all the necessary services in Rapla rural municipality. In order to provide the service, a new building will be built with the necessary premises and staff will be hired to manage the organisation of the service. In addition, group rooms will be built to reduce the shortage of kindergarten services in Rapla.

Selleks rajatakse Rapla linnas lasteaia Päkapikk juurde tugiteenuste kesksus, mis koordineerib ja korraldab kogu vajalike teenuste korraldust Rapla vallas. Operation_Name_English: Acquisition of a new ironing line for OÜ Pesulux

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project of OÜ Pesulux is to increase the production capacity of the company. In the framework of this project, an ironing line consisting of a feeder, a straight-wash ironing calender, a packer and a stacker will be purchased. As a result of the project, the productivity of the company will increase, as the new ironing line will be able to iron 2.5 times more laundry per hour, but at the same time will not require additional labour. In addition, the quality of the company's services, the working conditions of its employees and the preconditions for growth in turnover and value added are being created.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: OÜ Pesulux projekti eesmärk on suurendada ettevõtte tootmisvõimsust. Operation_Summary_English: The city of Narva, with the involvement of the heating company Narva Soojusvõrk AS, will carry out the necessary preliminary studies and analyses for the preparation of the Narva heat management development plan, as a result of which the development directions of the district heating area of the city of Narva have been developed for the further development of the heat management in the next ten years . The project contributes to the ability of the city and heat producers to prepare impactful projects that contribute to the decoupling of heat production from oil shale and the transition to 100% renewable sources of production.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Narva linn kaasates soojuseettevõtjat Narva Soojusvõrk ASi viib läbi vajalikud eeluuringud ja analüüsid Narva soojusmajanduse arengukava koostamiseks, mille tulemusena on välja töötatud Narva linna kaugküttepiirkonna arengusuunad soojusmajanduse edasiseks arenguks järgneva kümne aasta jooksul . Projekt panustab linna ja soojuse tootjate võimekusse ette valmistada mõjusaid projekte, mis aitavad kaasa soojustootmise lahtisidumisest põlevkivist ning 100% taastuvatele tootmisallikatele üleminekule.

Operation_Name_English: Tartu Rattaralli 2024 - UCI Gran Fondo World Series stage
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tartu Rattaralli 2024 - UCI Gran Fondo World Series sarja etapp

Operation_Summary_English: Tartu Rattaralli with a dignified history belongs to the renowned international series UCI Gran Fondo World Series. The aim of the project is to introduce one of the largest cycling festivals and destinations in the region abroad, create travel motivation and increase the number of foreign participants. The target groups of the project are cyclists, their companions and journalists in the following target countries: Finland, Latvia, Lithuania and Western and Central European cycling countries (England, Belgium, Netherlands).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Väärika ajalooga Tartu Rattaralli kuulub tunnustatud rahvusvahelisse sarja UCI Gran Fondo World Series. Projekti eesmärk on siinse regiooni ühe suurima rattafestivali ja sihtkoha tutvustamine välisriikides, reisimotivatsiooni tekitamine ning välisosalejate arvu kasvatamine. Projekti sihtrühmad on ratturid, nende kaaslased ning ajakirjanikud järgmistes sihtriikides: Soome, Läti, Leedu ning Lääne- ja Kesk-Euroopa rattariigid (Inglismaa, Belgia, Holland).

Operation_Summary_English: The depreciated main heater of the solid fuel in the dwelling is replaced by a heater that meets the standards set out in the regulation using renewable energy sources. The heating needs of the whole residential building are ensured with a heating device that is produced using modern and energy-saving technology, as well as following the environmentally friendly principle. Fire safety shall be ensured in the dwelling during the demolition of a depreciated furnace. When purchasing and installing the new furnace, it was taken into account that it is equipped and complies with modern standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Elamu tahkekütuse amortiseerunud põhi kütteseade asendatakse taastuvenergiaallikat kasutava määruses toodud standarditele vastava kütteseadmega. Our solution makes it easier and safer to store boats and helps save both time and money. The project enables to produce larger volumes of equipment in order to speed up the market entry, both in Estonia and Finland.

Operation_Summary_English: Within the framework of the project, a separate storm water system will be established in the area of Nelgi Road in Viimsi. The need to establish a rainwater system arises from the fact that although in Viimsi rural municipality there is a separate rainwater system, there is a large number of false connections of rainwater in the area of Nelgi Road, where rainwater has been discharged into the sewerage system, as there is no rainwater system on Nelgi Road. By establishing a rainwater system, a separate flow system is created in the area, which eliminates false connections and reduces the burden of rainwater on the wastewater treatment plant.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekti raames rajatakse Viimsis Nelgi tee piirkonda lahkvoolne sademeveesüsteem. Sademevee süsteemi rajamise vajalikkus tuleneb sellest, et kuigi Viimsi vallas on lahkvoolne sademeveesüsteem esineb Nelgi tee piirkonnas suur hulk sademevee valeühendusi kus sademevesi on juhitud reoveekanalisatsiooni, kuna Nelgi teel puudub sademeveesüsteem. Sademeveesüsteemi rajamisega luuakse piirkonda lahkvoolne süsteem misläbi likvideeritakse valeühendused ja väheneb sademevee koormus reoveepuhastile.

Operation_Name_English: CHARACTERISTICS – the journey continues.
Category_Label: Support to entities that provide services contributing to the low carbon economy and to resilience to climate change, including awareness-raising measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project focuses on training theatre volunteers in Ida-Viru County to integrate environmentally friendly practices into creative processes. In Tallinn, 12 young people participate in career days and practical training under the guidance of experts, learning how to create environmentally friendly stage designs, costumes and advertisements. After the Tallinn training period, the young people will organise three master classes for 60 participants in Ida-Viru County, sharing the acquired knowledge and promoting green values in the creative field among the young people of Ida-Viru County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt keskendub Ida-Virumaa teatrivabatahtlike koolitamisele , et integreerida loomeprotsessidesse keskkonnasõbralikke tavasid. Tallinnas osalevad 12 noort karjääripäevadel ja praktilisel koolitusel ekspertide juhendamisel , õppides, kuidas luua keskkonnasõbralikke lavakujundusi, kostüüme ja reklaame. Pärast Tallinna koolitusperioodi korraldavad noored Ida-Virumaal kolm meistriklassi 60 osalejale, jagades omandatud teadmisi ja edendades rohelisi väärtusi loomevaldkonnas Ida-Virumaa noorte seas.

Operation_Name_English: Design and production-ready deployment of a compound cell for a solid oxide electrolysis cell

Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: This project supports the broader objective of H2Electro to make hydrogen production greener by using solid oxide electrolysers. The project will develop a ground-breaking lithium cell design using state-of-the-art modelling techniques and electrochemical experiments. The innovative compound cell design increases the efficiency, durability and sustainability of the electrolyser, thereby significantly reducing CO 2 and SO x emissions from hydrogen production.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Antud projekt toetab H2Electro laiemat eesmärki muuta vesiniku tootmine rohelisemaks kasutades tahkeoksiidseid elektrolüüsereid. Projekti käigus arendatakse välja murranguline liitraku disain, kasutades tipptasemel modelleerimistehnikaid ja elektrokeemilisi eksperimente. Uudne liitraku disain suurendab elektrolüüseri efektiivsust, vastupidavust ja jätkusuutlikust vähendades seeläbi märkimisväärselt vesiniku tootmise CO 2 ja SO x heitmeid.

Operation_Name_English: A series of ethnographic heritage events on the northern coast of Lake Peipus
